verdict.rationale: The evidence pack names models (e.g. GPT-5.6 Terra/Luna) and documents a deprecations page with dated shutdowns. Nothing shows dated or versioned snapshot IDs that can be pinned, aliases that track the latest release, or a documented alias-to-version policy. The deprecations page is an adjacent lifecycle feature and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pin an exact versioned model ID while aliases track the latest release, with the alias-to-version policy documented
